package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestNormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleRequiresExactVersionedTargets(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	input := validPracticeEvidenceBundle(studentID)

	normalized, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle(studentID, input.EvidenceID, input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if normalized.RequestHash == "" || normalized.Evidence[0].Target.Version != "v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected normalized evidence: %+v", normalized)
	}

	input.Evidence[0].Target.Version = ""
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle(studentID, input.EvidenceID, input); !errors.Is(err, ErrEvidenceContract) {
		t.Fatalf("error = %v, want ErrEvidenceContract", err)
	}
}

func TestPracticeEvidenceReducerInputsMarksAssistedEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	input := validPracticeEvidenceBundle(studentID)
	hintLevel := 2
	input.HintsUsed = 1
	input.MaxHintLevel = &hintLevel
	normalized, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle(studentID, input.EvidenceID, input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	items, err := PracticeEvidenceReducerInputs(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(items) != 1 || items[0].Kind != EvidenceAssistedApplication || items[0].SupportContext != TeacherSupportGuided {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected reducer input: %+v", items)
	}
}

func TestNormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2BindsCanonicalActionAndOrderedTargets(t *testing.T) {
	studentID, instanceID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	input := validPracticeEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID)
	normalized, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID, input.EvidenceID, input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	items, err := PracticeEvidenceReducerInputsV2(normalized)
	if err != nil || len(items) != 1 || items[0].LearningActionID != input.LearningActionID {
		t.Fatalf("reducer must correlate to reserved action: items=%+v err=%v", items, err)
	}
	input.LearningActionID = input.EvidenceID
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID, input.EvidenceID, input); !errors.Is(err, ErrEvidenceContract) {
		t.Fatalf("same evidence/action identity error=%v", err)
	}
	input = validPracticeEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID)
	input.TaskRevisionDigest = "sha256:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID, input.EvidenceID, input); !errors.Is(err, ErrEvidenceContract) {
		t.Fatalf("uppercase digest error=%v", err)
	}
	input = validPracticeEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID)
	input.EvidenceID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-22222222222A"
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID, input.EvidenceID, input); !errors.Is(err, ErrEvidenceContract) {
		t.Fatalf("noncanonical evidence ID error=%v", err)
	}
	input = validPracticeEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID)
	input.WorkspaceDigest = " " + input.WorkspaceDigest
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID, input.EvidenceID, input); !errors.Is(err, ErrEvidenceContract) {
		t.Fatalf("whitespace digest error=%v", err)
	}
	input = validPracticeEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID)
	if _, err := NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID, " "+input.EvidenceID, input); !errors.Is(err, ErrEvidenceContract) {
		t.Fatalf("whitespace idempotency key error=%v", err)
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningTargetsOrderedEqualRejectsReorderedEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	first := LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}
	second := LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"}
	if PracticeLearningTargetsOrderedEqual([]LearningTargetRef{first, second}, []LearningTargetRef{second, first}) {
		t.Fatal("reordered targets must not bind to a frozen action")
	}
}

func validPracticeEvidenceBundle(studentID string) PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle {
	evidenceID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{
		Schema: PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV1, EvidenceID: evidenceID,
		StudentID: studentID, TaskInstanceID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", SubmissionID: evidenceID,
		Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "practice-assistance-v1",
		Evidence: []PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{
			Target:      LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"},
			Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 0.9, StepIDs: []string{"implement"},
		}},
		OccurredAt:    time.Date(2026, 9, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
		PolicyVersion: PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV1,
	}
}

func validPracticeEvidenceBundleV2(studentID, instanceID string) PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2 {
	evidenceID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	return PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{
		Schema: PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV2, EvidenceID: evidenceID,
		LearningActionID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", StudentID: studentID,
		TaskInstanceID: instanceID, TaskRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		WorkspaceDigest:    "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
		SubmissionID:       evidenceID, Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "practice-assistance-v1",
		Evidence:   []PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{Target: LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"}, Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 0.9, StepIDs: []string{"implement"}}},
		OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), PolicyVersion: PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2,
	}
}
